description: The official latest Mass Mobilization event files, current universe, official baseline and supplementary Coding Procedure remain unverified; this dossier uses a provisional assignment and historical protocol only.
required_followup: Compare with verified official event files and obtain the official supplementary procedure when available.

description: This first pass used open web search, not the original LexisNexis/newspaper retrieval protocol or complete publisher hemerotecas; search results cannot certify exhaustive coverage.
required_followup: Review with original newspaper frame and systematic archives if access becomes available.

description: Searches were primarily in French with some English. No systematic Lingala, Kituba/Munukutuba or other local-language press/archive search was completed.
required_followup: If feasible, consult fluent local-language searches and local-language archives; do not treat limited language coverage as evidence of absence.

description: The Jan. 31 CDEPE strike report does not establish actual work-stoppage participation, a public in-person gathering, or the 50-person threshold; 4,660 volunteer teachers assigned under the 2018 protocol is not protest turnout.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous school-level or independent reporting on whether the strike was observed, where, and by how many participants.

description: The three CDEPE strike reports are same-story variants in the ADIAC/Les Dépêches/Le Courrier network; Journal de Brazza explicitly credits ADIAC. They amount to one reporting origin, not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporary source or official/education-sector account.

description: The exact S001 Les Dépêches PDF URL was passed to web.open once after an earlier access review. The tool returned “URL is not accessible via this tool”; no HTTP status or denial evidence was provided. The source remains search_only and no alternative route was attempted.
required_followup: Retain the observed tool-only outcome. Any future body request must follow a fresh complete access gate; do not infer publisher denial or bypass the unavailable URL.

description: The S001 attempt’s saved gate documents 26 top-level registered physical ledgers plus 204 recursive canonical ledgers. After that attempt, the coordinator identified two additional nested physical source ledgers inside registered directories; both are reported byte-identical to already-scanned canonical histories. Preserve the earlier receipt unchanged: it does not document the later 28-physical-ledger scope. No other body attempt was made.
required_followup: No retry is planned for S001’s uncertain tool failure. Before any future body access to another source, complete and record the fresh 28-ledger recursive physical scan and all other required stable gates.

description: The sources do not report event-specific state action concerning the CDEPE strike. All seven state-response dimensions remain unknown; general social dialogue or unrelated government activity is not attributed to this event.
required_followup: Seek reporting that links a government action directly to the Jan. 31 strike.

description: The Dolisie municipal work stoppage is reported in December and January as continuing and is said to have lasted several months. A July 9 onset is reported for Dolisie among several municipalities, but Dolisie-specific continuity from that exact date and actual January restart are not established.
required_followup: Search for Dolisie-specific reporting on actual onset, intervening continuity, worker turnout/public action, and whether minimum services began after Jan. 16.

description: A single SACER report with unnamed sourcing alleges para-commando unrest and a planned palace march on Jan. 5. No independent contemporary confirmation or realized public protest was located in this pass.
required_followup: If the allegation becomes relevant to another research question, seek independent contemporary records; do not treat it as a protest candidate on this evidence.

description: The search pass covered national and local outlets, weekly issues, labor/education/health/police/political leads, and Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Dolisie references. Evidence remains thin outside web-indexed material, and no systematic local archive, regional-language or full-paper review was possible. No inference of zero protest events is warranted.
required_followup: Continue with local press archives and independent labor, student, health, rights and regional sources under the complete access protocol.
